title: Vikram and Betal: The Wise Old Woman
moral: Careful thinking leads to the right decision.

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a wise old woman.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a wise old woman from a village.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.summary: Two men argue over a pot of coins.
scenes.text: Two men claimed ownership of the same pot.
scenes.image_prompt: two men arguing over pot of coins cartoon

scenes.summary: The old woman observes the pot.
scenes.text: She kept the pot and carefully observed a mark on it.
scenes.image_prompt: old woman examining pot closely cartoon

scenes.text: She asked both men to describe the pot.
scenes.image_prompt: old woman questioning two men cartoon

scenes.text: The honest man described the mark correctly and got the pot. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: old woman giving pot to honest man cartoon

story: Two men argued over a pot of coins. A wise old woman observed a mark and tested them. The truthful man identified it correctly and received the pot. Vikram said wisdom comes from careful thinking.
